ns2:section.sectionText: Media, Politics, Self-Expression, Developmentalism and Its Discontents. This topic-orientated course uses lectures, site visits, and interactions with Chinese students to understand contemporary China from four perspectives Registration is restricted until students have been accepted into the program by the Study Abroad Office. See the following link for more information. http://app.studyabroad.illinois.edu/. This course runs the second eight weeks of the Fall semester, October 22, 2012 to December 12, 2012. The off campus component runs December 26, 2012 to January 11, 2013.
